Question: In \(\triangle ABC\) medians \(\overline{AD}\) and \(\overline{BE}\) intersect at \(G\) and \(\triangle AGE\) is equilateral. Then \(\cos(C)\) can be written as \(\dfrac{m\sqrt p}{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers and \(p\) is a positive integer not divisible by the square of any prime. What is \(m + n + p?\)
